Name: Personal Effects Redux
Author: ceruleandeep
Description:
[size=4][b]Personal Effects [/b][/size][size=3]could be considered a mod to improve the immersion of the game. It probably won't be. But it could. With this mod installed, some of your friendly village cohabitants will be a bit less careful with their, well, [i]personal effects[/i].  You might just occasionally catch a glimpse of an article of clothing left strewn out on the bedroom floor.
[/size][size=3]
[Some people have complained that the description is a bit too vague. hokay fine then... This tasteful, refined mod lets you find, collect, gift, and eat panties.]


[size=5][b]FEATURES[/b][/size]

[/size][list]
[*][size=3][b]Personal Effects [/b]will spawn rarely for each supported NPC.  These objects are cleared each day, they don't accumulate.[/size]
[*][size=3]Collect, return, gift... or eat. Eating a character's undies changes your relationship with them, obvs.
[/size]
[*][size=3]20 new quests added, more info below[/size]
[*][size=3]Configure NPCs on/off, change genders, even cross-dressing[/size]
[*][size=3]Multiple items per NPC means there are plenty of items to find[/size]
[*][size=3]Items might be found in the NPC's room (or home), around the bathhouse, or just occasionally, somewhere unexpected.[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[size=3][size=5][b]QUESTS
[/b][/size][/size]Help reunite the Valley with their lost underpants. For some reason, every time you reach 2-❤️ friendship with an NPC they need your help with an undies-related crisis. You're not sure why, but it's honest work and you learn a lot about their personal lives. 

Some of the spawn locations are very well-hidden, so the quests will give you useful clues if you're trying to complete a collection. It's also a way to play through the content while being respectful of characters' consent.

[/size][size=3][size=5][b]INSTALLATION[/b][/size][/size]

[list]
[*][size=3][b]REQUIRES SMAPI[/b][/size]
[*][size=3][b][size=3][b]REQUIRES [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]JSON ASSETS[/url]﻿[/b][/size][/b][/size]
[*][size=3][b][size=3]USES [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6414]QUEST FRAMEWORK[/url]﻿[/size][/b][/size]
[size=3]
[b]One file to download[/b]. Decompress the[b] combined archive [/b]from the Files section, then drag the 3 folders into your mods folder.

If you don't want to install Quest Framework or do the quests, delete the [QF] folder.
[/size][/list][size=3][size=5][b]
CUSTOMIZATION
[/b][size=3][size=5][size=3]You can add NPCs, add and change item locations, descriptions etc. New in 1.1.0. See the readme.txt in the archive which explains the json file layouts.[/size][/size][/size][b]

QUESTIONS?
[/b][/size][/size][size=3]First check the posts on the [/size][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3532]previous version[/url][/size][size=3]. The author provided a lot of information that I don't have.

[size=5][b]EX-FEATURES[/b][/size][/size][size=3][size=5][b]
[/b][/size][/size][size=3]These features of the previous version have been removed for the moment:[/size][size=3]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]spawning items as trash loot (dependency on bwdyworks was too deep to untangle)[/size]
[*][size=3][s]eating items (made it hard to gift/return the items and impossible to put them in the world)[/s] ermagerd finally fixed
[/size]
[/list][size=3][size=5][b]
